# `react/WorkspaceLegend`

Draws `LegendLine`s over the panes and nothing more: no reading, no formatting, no
decision about what a value means. Everything it shows was already decided in `layout/legendModel`.

## Example

```ts
import type { LegendLine } from 'lightweight-magic-charts';

export const lines: readonly LegendLine[] = [
  { id: 'price', title: 'Price action', topPx: 8, entries: [] },
];
```

## `WorkspaceLegendProps`

Derived from the interface and from the destructuring in the component, so a default that
changes in the code changes here.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lines` | `readonly LegendLine[]` | yes | — |
| `theme` | `WorkspaceTheme \| undefined` | no | `DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_THEME` |
| `testIdPrefix` | `string \| undefined` | no | `'chart-workspace-legend'` |
